Seaward Management Limited Partnership decreased its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.4% in the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the SEC. The institutional investor owned 734,769 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 17,879 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises 5.5% of Seaward Management Limited Partnership’s investment portfolio, making the stock its largest holding. Seaward Management Limited Partnership’s holdings in Apple were worth $113,242,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period. 
Other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also recently made changes to their positions in the company. Davis Rea LTD. boosted its position in Apple by 1.9% during the third quarter. Davis Rea LTD. now owns 35,934 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $5,538,000 after purchasing an additional 665 shares during the period. Cipher Capital LP bought a new stake in Apple during the third quarter worth approximately $1,763,000. Columbia Partners L L C Investment Management boosted its position in Apple by 6.0% during the third quarter. Columbia Partners L L C Investment Management now owns 167,696 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $25,845,000 after purchasing an additional 9,464 shares during the period. Check Capital Management Inc. CA boosted its position in Apple by 100.0% during the third quarter. Check Capital Management Inc. CA now owns 18,680 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,879,000 after purchasing an additional 9,340 shares during the period. Finally, Pictet North America Advisors SA boosted its position in Apple by 1.6% during the third quarter. Pictet North America Advisors SA now owns 249,495 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $38,452,000 after purchasing an additional 3,857 shares during the period. 59.70% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. Shares of Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) opened at $176.21 on Friday. Apple Inc. has a 1 year low of $137.05 and a 1 year high of $180.62. The firm has a market capitalization of $894,091.88, a price-to-earnings ratio of 18.11, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.33 and a beta of 1.19. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the business posted $3.36 earnings per share. The business’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. equities research analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.43 EPS for the current fiscal year. 
The business also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 12th were given a $0.63 dividend. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 1.43%. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, February 9th. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is 25.90%. 
AAPL has been the subject of a number of recent analyst reports. Macquarie set a $188.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Friday, January 26th. ValuEngine raised Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a research report on Sunday, December 31st. Zacks Investment Research raised Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $197.00 target price for the company in a research report on Thursday, January 18th. Barclays decreased their target price on Apple from $174.00 to $170.00 and set an “equal weight” rating for the company in a research report on Friday, February 2nd. Finally, Piper Jaffray Companies reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, January 2nd. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-four have given a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company. The stock currently has an average rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $201.58. 
In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the sale, the insider now owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through the SEC website . Corporate insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.
